subject: URGENT: Outstanding invoice INV-2026-09 & VAT documentation
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Emma Carter <emma@novusmed.com>, NovusMed Billing <billing@novusmed.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: URGENT: Outstanding invoice INV-2026-09 & VAT documentation

Hi Emma / NovusMed billing team,

Hope you're well. Our records show invoice INV-2026-09 (net EUR 63,200) is now 42 days past due. We haven't received remittance or formal confirmation of the VAT treatment you referenced on the PO. To avoid service interruption and to unblock collections, we need two items by COB Friday (2 Oct):

1) A copy of the payment remittance (or payment date if scheduled).
2) Definitive VAT evidence showing whether NovusMed is applying reverse-charge for the EU entity (entity and VAT number). If your AP needs a specific invoice entity, confirm that now so we can reissue.

If we don't get a response, the standard dunning cadence requires a credit hold escalation and potential suspension of non-production endpoints on Oct 6 — we'd prefer to avoid that.

Attached: INV-2026-09_NovusMed.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Proposed next step: If there is a genuine AP timing issue, we can accept a staged payment plan (e.g., 30% now, balance within 30 days) but we need written confirmation and remittance details.

Please let me know who in your team I should connect with directly for the VAT proof (sometimes internal procurement handles this).

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

---
From: Emma Carter <emma@novusmed.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: NovusMed Billing <billing@novusmed.com>, Aaron Liu <aaron.liu@procurex.co.uk>
Date: 2026-09-30T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: URGENT: Outstanding invoice INV-2026-09 & VAT documentation

Diego — thanks for the nudge and sorry for the delay. AP has been waiting on a corrective PO from Procurement; the delay is partly due to a split-invoice request between our UK and EU entities. We expect the PO to be raised today.

On VAT: NovusMed UK will apply reverse charge for the EU portion but we are still aligning the exact legal entity for the invoice. Procurement asked us to route VAT evidence through Aaron at Procurex (copied).

Payment timing: AP has committed to an initial payment of 20% within 5 business days once the corrective PO is in place; remainder will follow within 30 days. I understand this is not ideal — please escalate internally if the staged timeline requires leadership approval.

Attaching the AP contact card and a draft PO reference (will confirm final PO number tomorrow).

Emma Carter
Finance Business Partner — NovusMed
emma@novusmed.com

Attachments: novusmed_ap_contact.vcf (vCard), draft_po_note.txt (1KB)

Thanks Emma — appreciate the transparency. Looping in Kimberly (Credit Manager) and Jordan (Sales Lead) because the payment cadence you've outlined will need an exception to our standard dunning cadence and likely approval for a 60-day staging on the balance.

Quick internal asks (Kimberly / Jordan):
- Can we approve a temporary staged payment acceptance (20% on PO, 80% in 30 days) provided NovusMed delivers the PO and VAT evidence by EOD tomorrow?
- If we accept staging, can we agree to suspend further collection escalations and delay any service hold until Oct 15 to allow AP to process?

Emma, if you can confirm the final PO number and attach the VAT registration for the EU entity, we can draft the routing for reissuing the invoice or add a remit instruction to the existing invoice (whichever AP prefers).

Diego

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Emma Carter <emma@novusmed.com>, NovusMed Billing <billing@novusmed.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T16:47:00Z
Subject: Re: URGENT: Outstanding invoice INV-2026-09 & VAT documentation

Emma — thank you for the update and for coordinating with Procurement. I’m Kimberly (Credit Manager, Redwood). I reviewed the proposed plan with Jordan and we can approve an interim arrangement on the following conditions: 

1) Immediate: NovusMed to remit 25% of the outstanding balance by 2026-10-07 and provide the confirmed corrective PO number by EOD 2026-10-04.
2) VAT evidence: supply the EU entity VAT registration document and clarify if reverse-charge applies (PDF). We need that by 2026-10-04 to avoid reissuance delays.
3) Payment plan: outstanding balance to be paid in full by 2026-11-01. If the balance is not cleared by that date, Redwood will revert to the standard dunning sequence and may place a credit hold.
4) Documentation & sign-off: please return the attached short payment schedule signed by an authorized AP contact (attachment: proposed_payment_schedule_NovusMed.xlsx). Once we have the signed schedule and the 25% remittance, we will pause further escalation and delay a service hold until 2026-11-05.

This is a one-time concession tied to timely delivery of the PO and tax evidence. If you prefer, we can also prepare a DocuSign settlement letter for the 25% immediate payment and staged remainder — let us know.

If you expect any legal or treasury signoffs that will push dates, flag them now so we can escalate to leadership.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Credit Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed_payment_schedule_NovusMed.xlsx (XLSX, 14KB)
